title: A rate told at onboarding, after the notices, overrides them
found: A term with an open valid_to and a later recorded_at beats every materialised notice, which is what the bitemporal rule says. The world tells the rate at settlement. A household onboarding in 2030 and typing the 2028 rate would silently lose two years of notices, and L6 was the only alarm: it showed gaps of $149.13 a month on the first run.
want: init writes a setup rate with valid_to, or dates recorded_at at valid_from, so a notice can close it.
